description: This file defines a data structure 'GatewaySetupPayload' for storing gateway configuration parameters, along with a utility enum 'GatewaySetupCode' that provides methods to decode such payloads from raw strings, JSON, or base64-encoded data.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a raw string payload into a 'GatewaySetupPayload' object by attempting JSON decoding or base64 decoding.

methods.name: decodeFromJSON
methods.description: Decodes a JSON string into a 'GatewaySetupPayload' object.

methods.name: decodeBase64Payload
methods.description: Decodes a base64-encoded string into its original string payload.
